request.name: Mailchimp Search for Tags on a List by Name.

description.content: Search for tags on a list by name. If no name is provided, will return all tags on the list.

query.description: The search query used to filter tags.  The search query will be compared to each tag as a prefix, so all tags that have a name starting with this field will be returned.

variable.description: (Required) The unique ID for the list.
